correctness.rationale: In the fixed Z[ω,t]/(ω²+ω+1) cyclotomic source model, reduction at char3 sends ω↦1. Direct substitution into all twelve published conic forms gives nine copies of D=x²+y²+z²+(t+1)(xy+xz+yz), with the three remaining components A=xy−tz², B=xz−ty², C=yz−tx²; product is −D⁹ABC. When char(k)=3 and t≠0,1 the Hessian determinants are (−t,−t,−t,1−t³), all nonzero, so the reduced support is four distinct smooth conics. Independently expanded at P=[t:1:1], z=1, x=t+u,y=1+v: A=u+tv+uv, B=u+tv−tv², D=(t−1)(u+tv)+u²+v²+(t+1)uv. On B, u=−tv+tv² makes A=tv³; D vanishes to exact order 2 there and on A because (t−1)²≠0. Hence pairwise intersections (A,B),(A,D),(B,D) at P have multiplicities (3,2,2), and coordinate permutations give two others. The three coordinate vertices are transverse nodes. Each pair of distinct conics already uses total Bézout intersection 4 across identified points, exhausting all geometric intersections, not extrapolating finite-field checks. Delta=3·1+3·7=24; arithmetic genus 21 equals δ−4+1. All six singular points have coordinates in the field containing t; the claim concerns reduced support, not nonreduced scheme. Critical exact symbolic identities independently corroborated from actual package paths.
